goal: Implement the pure canonical gear Resolver and typed Evidence Ledger v1 on top of the approved Phase 1 contracts without activating a loader, facade, route, frontend, store or runtime consumer.
userValue: The future workbench can receive one deterministic server-owned resolved snapshot with explicit legality, static facts, constraints and evidence before any API or UI depends on it.
nonGoals: No PostgreSQL Authority Context loader or connection argument
No frontend transport, state or UI change
No migration, table, job, Worker, service, timer or cache state
No release registry or formal Active Season Manifest
No sync, write, backfill or cleanup change
No dependency installation or third-party download

mustChange: server/gear_resolver.py explicit slot and whole-character resolver
focused fixtures and unit tests for all new branches and errors
owner, verification, runbook and Strict release evidence
mustNotChange: server/websim_payload.py and server/news_backend.py current runtime behavior
database schema, migrations, writes and scheduled jobs
public observed-only entry and baseline-empty default
evidenceRequired: red and green tests for Evidence Ledger identity/source/dependency boundaries
red and green tests for Resolver preflight, slot order and whole-character facts
five typed claim groups and bounded dependsOn proof
zero database, facade and I/O coupling proof
local CR and git diff check
candidate remote import and pure resolver probes
unchanged live route, facade, public payload, timer and hash evidence

engineeringHealth.reason: Two new pure modules establish the canonical resolution boundary outside current hotspots; no active runtime module imports them in Slice 2A.

acceptanceEvidence: python3 -m unittest tests.gear_contracts_test tests.gear_result_envelope_test tests.gear_rule_matrix_test tests.gear_evidence_ledger_test tests.gear_resolver_test
zero database, facade and I/O coupling search plus Python compile
candidate remote Ledger/Resolver probes plus unchanged live runtime smokes

decisionLog.decision: Slice 2A contains pure Resolver and Ledger only; loader, store and facade parity are isolated to Slice 2B.
Resolver reuses Phase 1 parsing, signatures, problems and ordered rules instead of duplicating contracts.
Candidate deployment proves runtime-tree compatibility while /resolve and all current consumers remain unchanged.
